rationale: With only 11 minutes to close, any position risks forced liquidation at market, and URGN has shown extreme intraday volatility today (range from $34.18 to $40.05, roughly 17%). The last 5 candles show a steady drift lower with declining volume and no clear reversal signal, while the price sits between VWAP ($36.51) and the 9-EMA ($37.76) in a compressed, directionless chop. The risk/reward of entering a volatile pharmaceutical name this close to the forced close, with no news catalyst and an ATR that makes precise stop placement unreliable, does not justify a trade.
